overview: The Medford Community Development Board voted to recommend approval of a 65-unit mixed-use development on Winchester Street with conditions, and continued a public hearing for a seven-unit mixed-use project at 290 Salem Street.

items.title: 96–104 Winchester Street Special Permit and Site Plan Review
items.summary: The board voted to recommend City Council approval of a Planned Development District special permit and site plan review for a four-story, 65-unit residential building and a 4,000-square-foot commercial structure, incorporating conditions on noise mitigation for the proposed roof deck.

items.title: 290 Salem Street Special Permit and Site Plan Review
items.summary: The board opened a public hearing and reviewed plans for a three-story mixed-use building containing seven residential units and two ground-floor commercial spaces, voting to continue the hearing to March 6, 2024, pending Zoning Board of Appeals decisions on required variances.
